# PFW-005: SSH is not open to anywhere at the provider

- **Group:** Provider firewall
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

SSH open to the whole internet at the provider draws constant brute force traffic and exposes every future sshd flaw. A source of a /8 or wider counts as anywhere. Like NET-003, this is a failure when Tailscale offers a private path and a warning otherwise. The sshd ports come from the listeners (port 22 when they could not be read).

## Verify by hand

```sh
List the provider firewall's inbound TCP rules for the sshd ports and their sources
```

## How to fix it

Allow SSH at the provider only from the addresses you administer from (a panel, a bastion, your office), or close it there and reach SSH over the tailnet

## What a fix can break

Restricting SSH before another way in works locks you out; most providers still give a console in their web panel for that case.
